title: An algebraic17-atom operation on a supplied catalogue is not all-allocation optimization
statement: The algebraic supplied-catalogue bound remains17 atoms, distinct from optimal completed16. Earlier serialization failure and interrupted verification remain the actual failed attempts; this later source does not establish efficient discovery, bit complexity or attainment of the optimal16 support.
